title: An explainable machine learning model combining intratumoral and peritumoral computed tomography radiomics with maximum standard uptake value for predicting International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer grading and prognosis in stage I pure-solid lung adenocarcinoma.
summary: An explainable machine-learning model combined intratumoral and peritumoral CT radiomics with PET uptake to predict grading and prognosis in stage I pure-solid lung adenocarcinoma. Results are bounded to the reported retrospective cancer cohort.
ai_technology: Explainable machine-learning model using CT radiomics and PET uptake
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: The retrospective cohort evaluated prediction of clinical grading and prognostic outcomes using intratumoral and peritumoral features.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish prospective clinical benefit or generalization beyond the reported cohort.
evidence.ai_role: Explainable machine-learning model using CT radiomics and PET uptake

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
